mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals economic weakness that triggers immediate equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (supply shock) and rise in consumer price inflation (monetary policy failure) signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in housing starts signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 700 thousand units signal weak residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST < 700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 95), a rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95 and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
